title: Tiered Pricing
intro: While writing the Tiered Pricing test cases from the two PRDs, the Jira tickets, the developers' plans and the design, a few points came up that only you can decide. Each question shows a suggested answer; pick an option, add a note if you like, and press Save. Every saved answer is kept with your name and the time, so you can change your mind later.
preview: Preview for the QA lead: these 31 questions were sent to Matt in a Google Sheet on 16 Nov 2026. Answers saved on this page are not used.
